cases.action: Build routing, Bridge, Context, and packet for the repository candidate.
cases.expected_user_visible_result: The candidate is cold-reviewable but clearly non-executable.
cases.expected_state_change: Routing becomes HARD_STOP_LANE, execution_allowed is false, and the packet contains HALT.
cases.preserved_state: All protocol sources, examples, and acceptance plans remain inspectable.
cases.forbidden_result: Green candidate CI is treated as active execution authority.
cases.machine_check_mapping: run_checks verifies reference_candidate_non_executable and reference_candidate_packet_halts; CI verifies Reconcile remains blocked.

cases.action: Attempt to release non-LEAN execution using the fixture.
cases.expected_user_visible_result: Execution remains blocked until a real Codex return is reviewed by Brain.
cases.preserved_state: The fixture remains usable only as a structural example.

cases.action: Run changed-file and allowed-path checks from a clean committed branch.
cases.expected_user_visible_result: The committed file is detected and its leading dot remains intact.
cases.preserved_state: Absolute and parent-traversal paths remain invalid.
cases.forbidden_result: Clean worktree reports no changes or .github becomes github.

cases.action: Build the current Bridge and one complete Prompt.
cases.expected_user_visible_result: Codex can write machine evidence but cannot write Brain or human approval artifacts.
cases.expected_state_change: brain_semantic_review.json and acceptance_receipt.json are absent from executor_writable_outputs.
cases.preserved_state: Brain and user remain separate approval authorities.
cases.forbidden_result: Codex is instructed to update every observer output.

cases.action: Refresh deterministic runtime artifacts and verify the manifest and packet.
cases.expected_user_visible_result: The committed Prompt describes the same current task and inputs as the reviewed package.
cases.expected_state_change: Refresh produces no diff; Bridge and packet hashes match all current inputs and source bundle.
cases.preserved_state: Dynamic raw evidence remains separate from deterministic runtime freshness.
cases.forbidden_result: CI passes after silently regenerating a different Prompt only in its temporary workspace.
cases.machine_check_mapping: CI git diff --exit-code plus manifest_input_hashes_match, bridge_source_bundle_matches, and packet hash checks.

cases.action: Run Reconcile even if later files contain PASS-like values.
cases.expected_user_visible_result: Closure remains blocked because no execution occurred.
cases.expected_state_change: closure_ready remains false with explicit HARD_STOP, non-release, and HALT blockers.
cases.preserved_state: Human final closure remains possible only for a real active execution.
cases.forbidden_result: Edited receipts make an unexecuted task closure-ready.
